reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must accept SEARCH identifier-1 [VARYING identifier-2|index-name-1] [AT END imp-1] {WHEN condition-1 {imp-2|NEXT SENTENCE}}... [END-SEARCH] and SEARCH ALL identifier-1 [AT END imp-1] with exactly ONE WHEN whose operand is data-name-1 {IS EQUAL TO|IS =} {identifier-3|literal-1|arithmetic-expression-1} or condition-name-1 with repeated AND phrases, in that phrase order, and refuse every other shape (no NOT AT END, no second SEARCH ALL WHEN, no other relational operator, no subscripted identifier-1, AT END before the WHENs, at least one WHEN, imperative WHEN bodies).

edition-consulted.switches: ConstructRegistry.IsAvailable on a format's construct; both SEARCH formats carry Construct null (AT END alone, every edition)
FirstEditionWithSubscriptSentences (2002): the key-subscript sentences of the later SR are skipped at 85; the operand shape screen (EQUAL only, key on the left) is common
DialectBehavior.SearchIndexBelowTableUnsuccessful (a GR2a runtime matter, not the format)

refuter.evidence: Probes under E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-225/src at --std 85 (runs/). ra1 (accept): Format 2 with multi-key AND (EQUAL without IS/TO, condition-name-1 AND condition-name-2, EQUAL TO and IS EQUAL TO mixed, figurative ZERO as literal-1, arithmetic-expression-1, two-statement imperative-2, NEXT SENTENCE without END-SEARCH) and Format 1 with an abbreviated combined condition and NOT/AND: printed A-HIT 04 / B-HIT 03 / C-HIT 02 / D-NONE / E-HIT 01 / E-SECOND / F-AFTER 01 / G-HIT 03 / H-HIT 02, all right. Refusals: rb1 OR in Format 2 (COBOL1757), rb2 parenthesized WHEN (COBOL1757), rb3 IS NOT EQUAL TO (COBOL1757), rb4 NOT condition-name (COBOL1757), rb5 SEARCH ALL with no WHEN (COBOL0001), rb6 Format 1 AT END after WHEN (COBOL0001), rb7 AND ... OR (COBOL1757), rb9 SEARCH ALL second WHEN + trailing AT END (COBOL2269), rb10 key on the right of the AND phrase (COBOL1965/1966), rc2 EQUALS (COBOL5506). rc1 Format 1 WHEN K (IX) >= 3 compiles and runs: legal, since the 1985 relational-operator table lists IS >= (spec line 5990) and SR3 admits any conditional expression. rb8 (same key twice under AND) compiles: not a format matter (SR4), and the 1985 text does not forbid it in words. cite.py: OK §1985:VI.6.22.2 [SEARCH ALL identifier-1 [AT END imperative-statement-1]]; OK §1985:VI.6.22.3 SR3 [condition-1 may be any conditional expression].
